review.imagery: Twenty own-project native brochure renders were visually reviewed against the complete source pages and current gallery. They cover the whole tower, facade, aerial, pools, leisure areas, lobby and home interiors. Decorative strips, empty framing layers, generic people/city photographs and repeated current-gallery crops are excluded. The complete page-12 street view supplies the card and hero. Original embedded branding is preserved. Fitout and views remain proposed and unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: The original official brochure shows four home layouts on three complete sheets. The studio sheet includes both a pool and a non-pool variant. Drawing-specific areas, numbered unit matching and building floorplates were not established in the reviewed accessible sources. Confirm the approved configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. All three complete physical pages 27–29 were visually reviewed, including both studio variants on page 27. No area is inferred from generic category minima or broker ranges. Search found broker variants and a sales-offer reference, but no accessible independently attributable complete floorplate pack was established. Tanami’s download requires contact details and was not submitted. The HN reference could not be fetched.
review.location: Complete original regional illustration page 30 and all ten time entries on page 31 were visually reviewed. Current-primary travel differences are explicitly qualified. The name-only official map query is recorded with source hash. No coordinate, direct road frontage, live route, distance or campus identity is invented.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, original official brochure bytes and native image origins retain source receipts and hashes. Original sheets, branding and physical PDF links are preserved. This is Manhattan Phase II, separate from the original Manhattan. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, approved unit matching, an accessible complete building floorplate pack, exact university campus, final fitout, verified visitor entrance coordinates and dated construction photographs were not established.
